teaser.en: One of its Digo names simply means 'trap', because that is what its sticks become.
teaser.sw: Mojawapo ya majina yake ya Kidigo lina maana ya 'mtego' tu, kwa sababu hivyo ndivyo vijiti vyake vinavyogeuka kuwa.

summary.en: *Mkete* is a small coastal forest tree of the fig family, with toothed leaves and white latex. Its sticks are made into traps, which gives it its other name, *msusu*.
summary.sw: *Mkete* ni mti mdogo wa msitu wa pwani wa familia ya mitini, wenye majani yenye meno pembeni na utomvu mweupe. Vijiti vyake hutengenezwa kuwa mitego, na hilo ndilo linalompa jina lake jingine, *msusu*.

about.en: *Mkete* is a small tree of the forest understorey. Its leaves have toothed edges, and like its relatives in the fig family it bleeds a white latex when cut.
about.sw: *Mkete* ni mti mdogo wa sehemu ya chini ya msitu. Majani yake yana meno pembeni, na kama jamaa zake wa familia ya mitini, hutoa utomvu mweupe ukikatwa.

where.en: It grows in coastal forest, in the shade of taller trees.
where.sw: Hukua katika msitu wa pwani, kivulini mwa miti mirefu zaidi.

uses.en: The sticks are cut and made into traps, known as *susu*.
uses.sw: Vijiti vyake hukatwa na kutengenezwa kuwa mitego, inayojulikana kama *susu*.

names.en: Pakia records two Digo names, *mkete* and *msusu*. *Msusu* means 'trap', after the traps made from its sticks; the same name is used in Swahili. No English name is in common use.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi majina mawili ya Kidigo, *mkete* na *msusu*. *Msusu* maana yake ni 'mtego', kutokana na mitego inayotengenezwa kwa vijiti vyake; jina hilo hilo linatumika kwa Kiswahili. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza linalotumika kwa kawaida.

reason.sw: Jamaa wa familia ya mitini mwenye utomvu mweupe

reason.en: Also named after the object made from it
reason.sw: Pia umepewa jina kutokana na kitu kinachotengenezwa kwake

reason.en: Its name also means the tool made from it
reason.sw: Jina lake pia lina maana ya zana inayotengenezwa kwake

reason.en: Small fig-family tree named for its use
reason.sw: Mti mdogo wa familia ya mitini uliopewa jina kutokana na matumizi yake
